verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an LLM gateway/SDK, but the evidence documents no sandbox environment. The only related feature is a request-level `mock_response` mode, which is a dry-run mock and not an isolated sandbox. The docs say explicitly that it is "not a hosted sandbox environment; no separate sandbox deployment is documented." Traffic mirroring sends production traffic to a silent model, and self-hosting a separate proxy would be a user-side workaround, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
